svg.title: Share groups: consumers sharing a partition
svg.desc: Three consumers read a topic with one partition. In a consumer group, Consumer 1 gets the partition and the other two sit idle. In a share group all three get it: the broker locks each record to one consumer until it is acknowledged, and when Consumer 2 stalls on offset 4, its lock runs out and Consumer 3 gets the record as a second delivery.

g.text: A consumer group: one consumer per partition
Partition 0 goes to Consumer 1, so Consumers 2 and 3 sit idle.
In a share group, all three get partition 0
The broker hands out single records instead of whole partitions.
Each record goes to one consumer
It stays locked to that consumer until acknowledged, and records finish in any order.
The others keep going, but the start offset cannot pass offset 4.
The lock runs out, and offset 4 goes out again
Consumer 3 gets it as a second delivery, and the start offset catches up.
acquired: locked to Consumer 2 until it acknowledges it
acknowledged: done, and never delivered again
available: free for any consumer to acquire
start offset: every record before it is acknowledged
